## Data

```{r}
#| label: data

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

all_null_perf <- read.csv("all_null_perf.csv")
all_upper_bounds_max <- read.csv("all_upper_bounds_max.csv")
all_upper_bounds <- read.csv("all_upper_bounds_95%.csv")

nba_full <- read.csv("full_1_57_dperf.csv")
nba_full <- nba_full %>%
  filter(game_time_min <= 48)


dperf_cols <- names(nba_full)[grepl("^dPerf_", names(nba_full))]


players <- names(nba_full) %>%
  str_subset("^Perf_") %>%
  str_remove("^Perf_")

filter_player_games <- function(data, player, threshold = 10){

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  data %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > threshold) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

## Plot Simulated and real games with Strict Bound

```{r}
#| label: get real game data
real_long <- map_dfr(players, function(p) {

  perf_col  <- paste0("Perf_", p)
  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", p)

  nba_full %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(game_id, game_time_min, !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    rename(obs_perf = !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    filter(!is.na(obs_perf))
})
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)

p <- "shai_gilgeous_alexander"

# simulated games
p_null <- all_null_perf %>%
  filter(player == p)

# bounds
p_bound_95 <- all_upper_bounds %>%
  filter(player == p) %>%
  arrange(game_time_min)

p_bound_max <- all_upper_bounds_max %>%
  filter(player == p) %>%
  arrange(game_time_min)

# interpolate bounds + create shading
p_null_shaded <- p_null %>%
  arrange(sim_game, game_time_min) %>%
  group_by(sim_game) %>%
  mutate(
    upper_95 = approx(p_bound_95$game_time_min, p_bound_95$upper_line,
                      xout = game_time_min, rule = 2)$y,
    upper_max = approx(p_bound_max$game_time_min, p_bound_max$upper_line,
                       xout = game_time_min, rule = 2)$y,

    # blue region (above 95)
    shade95_ymin = upper_95,
    shade95_ymax = ifelse(sim_Perf > upper_95, sim_Perf, upper_95),

    # red region (above max)
    shadeMax_ymin = upper_max,
    shadeMax_ymax = ifelse(sim_Perf > upper_max, sim_Perf, upper_max)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(p_null_shaded, aes(x = game_time_min, y = sim_Perf)) +

  # 🔵 above 95th
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = shade95_ymin, ymax = shade95_ymax, group = sim_game),
    fill = "blue",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +

  # 🔴 above max (on top)
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = shadeMax_ymin, ymax = shadeMax_ymax, group = sim_game),
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # simulated paths
  geom_step(
    aes(group = sim_game),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # bounds
  geom_line(
    data = p_bound_95,
    aes(x = game_time_min, y = upper_line),
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = p_bound_max,
    aes(x = game_time_min, y = upper_line),
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Null Games with Heat Regions for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander",
    subtitle = "<span style='color:blue;'>95% Bound</span> vs <span style='color:red;'>Max Bound</span>",
    x = "Game Time (Minutes)",
    y = "Cumulative Performance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown()
  )
```

## Event dist.

```{r}
plot_event_times_all_games <- function(data, dperf_col, time_col = "game_time_min") {

  all_events <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    select(game_id, event_time = all_of(time_col))

  ggplot(all_events, aes(x = event_time, y = factor(game_id))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Event Times Distribution Across Games for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander",
      x = "Event time (minutes)",
      y = "Games"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),   # 👈 removes labels
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()   # 👈 removes tick marks
    )
}
plot_event_times_all_games(nba_full, dperf_col = "dPerf_shai_gilgeous_alexander")
```

## Heat Area

```{r}
#| label: heat area function for real games

detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_upper_bounds_max,
                                                    digits = 1, area_digits = 2) {

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds_max %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  player_games <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    distinct(game_id)

  blocks <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = approx(
        x = bound_df$game_time_min,
        y = bound_df$upper_line,
        xout = game_time_min,
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above, default = FALSE),
        ((excess + lag(excess, default = 0)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      area = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  heat_summary <- blocks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  player_games %>%
    left_join(heat_summary, by = "game_id") %>%
    mutate(
      n_intervals = ifelse(is.na(n_intervals), 0L, n_intervals),
      intervals = ifelse(is.na(intervals), "", intervals),
      areas = ifelse(is.na(areas), "", areas),
      durations = ifelse(is.na(durations), "", durations),
      total_heat_area = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_area), 0, total_heat_area),
      total_heat_time = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_time), 0, total_heat_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: heat table obs
heat_tables_obs <- map_dfr(players, function(p) {

  detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact(
    player_name = p,
    real_long = real_long,
    all_upper_bounds_max = all_upper_bounds_max
  ) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    select(player, everything())

})

heat_tables_obs
```

## More Summary Stats + visuals

```{r}
#| label: top50 games

top50_games_obs <- heat_tables_obs %>%
  arrange(desc(total_heat_area)) %>%
  slice(1:50)

top50_games_obs
```

```{r}
#| label: plot top 50 games
for(i in 1:nrow(top50_games_obs)){

  p  <- top50_games_obs$player[i]
  g  <- top50_games_obs$game_id[i]
  area_val <- round(top50_games_obs$total_heat_area[i], 2)
  time_val <- round(top50_games_obs$total_heat_time[i], 2)

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds_max %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  # real game
  game_data <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == p, game_id == g) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

    game_data <- game_data %>%
      mutate(
        upper_line = approx(
          x = bound_df$game_time_min,
          y = bound_df$upper_line,
          xout = game_time_min,
          rule = 2
        )$y,
        above = obs_perf > upper_line,
        shade_ymin = upper_line,
        shade_ymax = ifelse(above, obs_perf, upper_line)
      )

    print(
      ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +

        # shaded region above upper bound
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax),
          alpha = 0.25
        ) +

        # observed line
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +

        # upper bound
        geom_line(
          aes(y = upper_line),
          color = "red",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.7
        ) +

        theme_minimal() +
        labs(
          title = paste("Player:", p),
          subtitle = paste(
            "Game ID:", g,
            "| Total Heat Area:", area_val,
            "| Total Heat Minutes:", time_val
          ),
          x = "Game Time (minutes)",
          y = "Cumulative Performance"
        )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: summary stats (mean heat of only hot games)
player_summary_hot <- heat_tables_obs %>%
  filter(player != "josh_hart") %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    total_games = n(),
    total_hot_games = sum(total_heat_area > 0),
    prop_hot_games = total_hot_games / total_games,
    mean_heat_hot = ifelse(
      total_hot_games > 0,
      mean(total_heat_area[total_heat_area > 0]),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_heat = max(total_heat_area),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_heat_hot))   # remove players with no mean heat
library(kableExtra)
player_summary_hot %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_heat_hot)) %>%
  mutate(
    player = str_replace_all(player, "_", " "),
    player = str_to_title(player)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Player` = player,
    `Total Games` = total_games,
    `Hot Games` = total_hot_games,
    `Proportion Hot` = prop_hot_games,
    `Mean Heat` = mean_heat_hot,
    `Max Heat` = max_heat
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Mean Heat` = round(`Mean Heat`, 2),
    `Max Heat` = round(`Max Heat`, 2),
    `Proportion Hot` = round(`Proportion Hot` * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Player Heat Summary (Hot Games Only)",
    align = "c"
  )
```

```{r}
    y = "Mean Heat Area (Hot Games)"
  )
```

```{r}
obs_final_perf <- real_long %>%
  arrange(player, game_id, game_time_min) %>%
  group_by(player, game_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_perf = last(obs_perf),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

player_end_perf_summary <- obs_final_perf %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    n_games = n(),
    mean_end_perf = mean(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_end_perf = sd(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_end_perf = min(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_end_perf = max(final_perf, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

clean_player <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "") %>%       
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")%>%
    str_replace("p_j_washington", "pj_washington")
}

player_end_plus_summary <- player_end_perf_summary %>%
  mutate(player_clean = clean_player(player)) %>%
  inner_join(
    player_avgs_2024_25 %>%
      mutate(player_clean = clean_player(athlete_display_name)),
    by = "player_clean"
  ) %>%
  select(player = player, mean_end_perf, ppg, apg, orpg, drpg, spg, bpg)


```

```{r}
player_end_plus_summary <- player_end_plus_summary %>%
  mutate(
    player = str_replace_all(player, "_", " "),
    player = str_to_title(player)
  )
player_end_plus_summary
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_long <- player_end_plus_summary %>%
  mutate(
    rpg = orpg + drpg
  ) %>%
  select(player, mean_end_perf, ppg, apg, rpg) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ppg, apg, rpg),
    names_to = "stat",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stat = recode(
      stat,
      ppg = "Points Per Game",
      apg = "Assists Per Game",
      rpg = "Rebounds Per Game"
    )
    
  )%>%
  mutate(
    stat = factor(
      stat,
      levels = c("Points Per Game", "Assists Per Game", "Rebounds Per Game")
    )
  )

library(ggrepel)

# choose players to label (top 8 by performance)
label_df <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(stat) %>%
  slice_max(mean_end_perf, n = 4)

ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = value, y = mean_end_perf)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +

  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = str_to_title(str_replace_all(player, "_", " "))),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 100
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ stat, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Traditional Box Score Stats vs Mean End-of-Game Performance",
    x = "Per Game Average",
    y = "Mean End-of-Game Performance"
  )
```
